items.title: The Best-Laid SCHEMEs: Coordinated Sabotage and Monitoring in Multi-Agent Systems
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2605.29178v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: As agentic coding systems decompose work across multiple model instances, a critical safety question is whether those instances can coordinate to achieve a hidden malicious objective while appearing aligned with user intent. We introduce SCHEME, a benchmark of 11 task pairings across 7 settings built on real open-source libraries, each connecting a legitimate software-engineering task with a malicious side task. Side tasks are designed so that no proper subset of agents can complete them alone: agents must decompose a shared plan, relay partial requirements, and make mutually consistent edits. Evaluating ten frontier models, we find that coordinated sabotage is already practical, with models completing the malicious objective while succeeding on the legitimate task in 49\% to 85\% of trajectories. items.summary_zh: 论文关注 agentic 编程系统把工作拆分给多个模型实例时的安全风险：这些实例是否会协同实现隐藏的恶意目标，同时表面上仍符合用户意图。作者提出 SCHEME 基准，基于真实开源库构建 7 种设置下的 11 组任务配对，每组都包含可被协同利用的隐藏目标与相应监控条件，用于系统评估多智能体协同破坏的可检测性与监控手段的有效性。

items.title: [OpenAI] SpaceX 主任工程師教你：讓 AI 少寫垃圾
items.raw_text:
大家都在罵 AI 寫的程式碼是垃圾。SpaceXSI 主任工程師 Lauren Tan（@poteto）在 AI Engineer Code Summit 2026 的演講〈All Code Is Slop (Except Mine)〉說：寫垃圾的從來不只 AI，AI 只會把它身邊的環境放大。

她的團隊一個月合併一萬多個 PR，撤回比例反而從 0.98% 降到 0.47%。這支影片整理她怎麼做到：把每次糾正變成確定性檢查、拿掉難用的東西、把驗證做好，最後才輪到軟體工廠。
items.reason_zh: SpaceX 主任工程师分享真实工程实践：如何通过确定性检查、环境优化和验证流程，让 AI 生成的代码质量大幅提升，PR 撤回率从 0.98% 降至 0.47%。
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 主任工程师 Lauren Tan 在 AI Engineer Code Summit 2026 的演讲中指出，AI 生成的代码质量差并非 AI 独有，而是放大了周围环境的问题。她的团队每月合并超过一万个 PR，撤回比例从 0.98% 降至 0.47%。核心做法包括：将每次纠正转化为确定性检查、移除难用的工具、做好验证流程，最后才构建软件工厂。这套方法强调工程环境与流程的优化，而非单纯依赖模型能力。
items.title_zh: [OpenAI] SpaceX 主任工程师教你：让 AI 少写垃圾

items.title: Social Interaction Breaks Replicate Independence in Controlled-Clone LLM Agents
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.29581v2 Announce Type: replace 
Abstract: Multi-agent LLM evaluations and social simulations create many agents from one model and treat them as independent replicates, even after the agents interact. This assumption remains untested with matched controls. We introduce SocCogEval, a controlled-clone assay for Social Cognitive Transfer (SCT). Clones share the base model, system prompt, and decoding parameters and differ only in a private brief, and a factorial protocol separates the brief, 30 rounds of interaction, and initialization noise. On Qwen3-122B-FP8, interaction with the briefs held fixed raises off-topic BFI-10 response-profile drift by $\bar{\Delta}=+0.917$ and $+0.912$ in two topically disjoint scenarios (exact $p=0.0008$ and $0.0039$). The drift is larger than under the brief alone, persists under temperature-zero re-probing, and stays positive without typed memory extraction in exploratory tests. items.reason_zh: 用受控克隆实验挑战多智能体评估中'克隆即独立重复'的默认假设，方法论上值得警惕。
items.summary_zh: 论文检验多智能体 LLM 评估与社会模拟中的一个常见假设：由同一模型生成的多个 agent 即使已经交互过，仍被当作相互独立的重复样本。作者提出 SocCogEval，一种用于社会认知迁移（SCT）的受控克隆实验方法，克隆体共享基础模型、系统提示等条件，并设置匹配对照组。结果显示社会交互会破坏克隆体之间的独立性，提示现有评估与模拟结论可能因此产生偏差。

items.title: 如何在“不能出错”的系统里使用 AI Coding？分布式存储实践与边界
items.raw_text: 本文结合美团基础技术部在 AI 评审、问题排查和自动化开发中的真实实践，分享 AI 能帮上什么忙、容易在哪些地方犯错，以及哪些地方仍需要人来把关。比「多写代码」更重要的，是让代码和结论经得起验证。
items.reason_zh: 一线团队复盘 AI Coding 在零容错系统中的真实边界，踩坑经验可迁移。
items.summary_zh: 文章结合美团基础技术部在分布式存储场景中的实践，分享 AI Coding 在代码评审、问题排查和自动化开发中的真实表现。作者重点讨论 AI 能帮上忙的环节、容易出错的典型场景，以及哪些关键判断仍需人工把关，强调在「不能出错」的系统中，比多写代码更重要的是让代码与结论经得起验证。内容属于工程师对真实系统设计取舍与边界的复盘，对在关键系统中引入 AI 辅助开发的团队有较强参考价值。

items.title: When Successful Collaboration Becomes an Attack Surface: Insider Memory Poisoning in Multi-Agent Systems
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.31307v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recent Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) increasingly use shared memory to store and reuse successful collaboration records, enabling teams to improve across tasks. However, this memory introduces a new attack surface for malicious insiders. Unlike existing insider attacks that inject misleading information directly into the current collaboration, misinformation stored in shared memory can later appear as successful team experience and gain greater credibility and influence. We propose MIMPA (Multi-Agent Insider Memory Poisoning Attack), which exploits this vulnerability using only normal participation privileges, without direct memory access. During an earlier task, the malicious agent embeds a target-specific payload while helping the team answer correctly, allowing the payload to be retained in a successful collaboration record. items.reason_zh: 揭示多智能体系统共享记忆可被内部人员投毒的新攻击面，对设计MAS安全机制有直接启发。
items.summary_zh: 该arXiv论文研究多智能体系统（MAS）中的新型安全风险：系统 increasingly 使用共享记忆存储并复用成功的协作记录，以提升跨任务表现，但这一机制为恶意内部人员提供了新的攻击面。与以往直接向当前协作注入误导信息的内部攻击不同，本文关注通过污染共享记忆、让错误信息在后续任务中被反复复用的“内部记忆投毒”路径。论文分析了该攻击的机理与影响，并讨论相应的防御思路，对多智能体系统的安全设计具有参考意义。
items.title_zh: 当成功协作成为攻击面：多智能体系统中的内部记忆投毒

items.title: Beyond Autoregression: Diffusion Language Model is All Analog In-Memory Computing Need
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2611.32223v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) enables energy-efficient language-model inference, but hardware non-idealities perturb matrix--vector multiplications and degrade generation quality. Autoregressive (AR) models are especially vulnerable: each token is committed to the causal context at birth, so perturbation-induced errors cascade. We study diffusion language models (DLMs), which iteratively refine a masked sequence, as an alternative paradigm. Across scale-matched model pairs and open checkpoints, DLMs degrade more gracefully than AR counterparts under persistent weight perturbations. Controlled analyses rule out cross-round noise averaging and support delayed token commitment and progressive context resolution as the mechanism. A larger denoising-step budget further shrinks the clean--noisy gap, a DLM-specific latency--robustness knob. items.summary_zh: 论文研究模拟存内计算（AIMC）用于语言模型推理时的硬件非理想性问题：矩阵向量乘法受扰动会降低生成质量。自回归模型尤为脆弱，因为每个token在生成时即被写入因果上下文，扰动引起的错误会沿序列级联放大。作者转而研究扩散语言模型在该硬件上的表现，论证其非逐token提交的生成方式对硬件噪声更具鲁棒性，从而更适合模拟存内计算平台。

items.title: AI agents now control part of Deepmind's compute for Gemini experiments, but recursive self-improvement remains distant
items.raw_text:
Google Deepmind uses AI agents to run experiments on their own for upcoming Gemini models. Research chief Koray Kavukcuoglu says the lab is still far from recursive self-improvement. For oversight, Deepmind intentionally leaves the agents' internal chains of thought untrained so they can be reviewed. Kavukcuoglu measures AGI by everyday user trust rather than benchmarks.

items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 研究主管 Koray Kavukcuoglu 表示，AI agent 现已控制部分算力，用于为即将推出的 Gemini 模型自主运行实验。这标志着 AI 在自动化研究流程方面取得进展，但递归自我改进仍然遥远。该报道揭示了前沿实验室如何利用 AI 加速模型开发，同时澄清了当前能力边界，避免过度炒作。内容涉及算力分配、实验自动化与自我改进等关键议题。

items.title: Claude rewrote the API that serves Claude. Checking its work was harder
items.raw_text:
Anthropic has moved its Messages API from Python to Rust with Claude agents writing and fixing much of the code. Its tests could not be trusted, so it compared the two versions on live traffic, and says the new API uses about 70% less CPU per request. Anthropic has moved the main API behind Claude […]



This story continues at The Next Web
items.reason_zh: Anthropic 用 Claude 重写自家 API 并因测试不可信改用线上流量对比验证，是 agent 参与核心工程的难得真实案例。
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 将其 Messages API 从 Python 迁移到 Rust，其中大量代码由 Claude agent 编写和修复。团队发现自动生成的测试本身不可信，无法作为正确性依据，于是改为在真实线上流量上并行对比新旧两个版本的行为，以此验证迁移是否等价。Anthropic 表示新 API 每次请求的 CPU 消耗降低约 70%。这一案例揭示了 agent 参与核心基础设施改造时的关键难点：验证与信任成本往往高于代码生成本身。
items.title_zh: Claude 重写了服务 Claude 的 API，而验证它的工作更难

items.title: ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework
items.raw_text:
Laminar is an open-source asynchronous RL post-training framework from HKU and ByteDance Seed researchers. It decouples rollout, training and weight sync, and lifted Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B to 52.2% on SWE-bench Verified.

The post ByteDance Researchers Open-Sources Laminar, an Async Reinforcement Learning RL Post-Training Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost.
items.reason_zh: 字节 Seed 与港大开源异步 RL 后训练框架 Laminar，解耦 rollout、训练与权重同步，附 SWE-bench 结果。
items.summary_zh: 香港大学与字节跳动 Seed 的研究者开源了异步强化学习后训练框架 Laminar。其核心设计是把 rollout、训练与权重同步三个环节解耦，从而支持异步执行，提升后训练流程的吞吐与效率。报道称该框架将 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 在 SWE-bench Verified 上的成绩提升至 52.2%。文章以项目介绍为主，给出了关键设计思路与一项基准结果，但未展开完整的实验设置与消融分析。
items.title_zh: 字节跳动研究者开源异步强化学习后训练框架 Laminar

items.title: 做了 16 年数据库，蚂蚁 OceanBase 为什么要再造一个 AI 数据平台？

items.summary_zh: InfoQ 文章围绕蚂蚁 OceanBase 在深耕数据库 16 年后为何要再造一个 AI 数据平台展开。内容涉及 AI 应用对数据层提出的新需求，例如向量检索、多模态数据处理、混合负载与实时性要求，以及传统关系型数据库在这些场景下的局限。文章还讨论了 OceanBase 如何在既有分布式数据库能力之上扩展面向 AI 的数据平台，包括架构演进思路与工程取舍，属于对国产数据库厂商 AI 化转型路径的技术性梳理。
